"""eai-standard/2.x client (formerly rcb-limited/2.x) — the only thing a standard-mode agent gets (installed at /opt/tools/rcb_client.py).

    from rcb_client import Robot
    r = Robot()                                   # finds the service (sim:8000, then localhost:8000), waits for warm-up
    spec = r.spec()                               # action types + dims + limits, cameras, budgets
    obs = r.get_obs()                             # current frames: obs.last["head_camera"] -> uint8 HxWx3, obs.meta["proprio"]
    res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.05)    # actions: (T, 14); returns the execution video
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", actions)                    # (T, 16); planner per row (see spec)
    res.video["head_camera"]  -> mp4 bytes     res.frames["head_camera"] -> uint8 (N,H,W,3) if video="frames"/"both"
    res.last["left_camera"]   -> uint8 HxWx3   res.proprio -> float32 (N, 30)   res.meta -> dict (done, plan, clipped, ...)
    res.save("/app/runs/003")                  # meta.json, <cam>.mp4, frames/<cam>/NNN.jpg, last/<cam>.jpg, proprio.npy

+"""RoboTwin 2.0 shake_bottle controller, eai-standard/2.1.
+
+This is the live episode controller. It keeps the unused arm parked, estimates
+the bottle from camera/depth frames, and uses the left arm because the bottle
+is on the left side of the table.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+s = r.spec()
+obs = r.get_obs(cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera", "observer_camera", "world_camera1"),
+                include_depth=True, video="none")
+now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+q_left = now[17:21].copy()
+q_right = now[24:28].copy()
+print("episode", {k: obs.meta.get(k) for k in ("step", "calls", "sim_time_s", "time_left_s", "done")})
+print("left/right EE", now[14:21].tolist(), now[21:28].tolist())
+print("camera inputs", list(obs.last), list(obs.depth))
+
+
+def ee_row(left_xyz, left_q, left_grip, right_xyz=None, right_q=None, right_grip=1.0):
+    """Build a valid 16D ee_pose row; points are RoboTwin's ee frames."""
+    if right_xyz is None:
+        right_xyz = now[21:24]
+    if right_q is None:
+        right_q = now[24:28]
+    return np.asarray([*left_xyz, *left_q, left_grip, *right_xyz, *right_q, right_grip], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def execute(name, rows):
+    global obs, now
+    result = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), video="mp4", note=name)
+    result.save(str(OUT / name))
+    print(name, json.dumps(result.meta, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, "tolist") else str(x)))
+    if result.proprio is not None and len(result.proprio):
+        print("last sampled proprio", result.proprio[-1].tolist())
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera", "observer_camera", "world_camera1"),
+                    include_depth=True, video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+    print("after", {k: obs.meta.get(k) for k in ("step", "calls", "sim_time_s", "time_left_s", "done")})
+    print("EE", now[14:28].tolist(), "TCP", now[56:70].tolist(), "grippers", now[36], now[43])
+    for cam, img in obs.last.items():
+        from PIL import Image
+        Image.fromarray(img).save(OUT / f"{name}_{cam}.png")
+    return result
+
+
+# Initial motion only. Later stages are appended after inspecting the approach.
+left_pregrasp_ee = np.asarray([-0.155, -0.120, 0.880], dtype=np.float32)
+execute("001_pregrasp", [ee_row(left_pregrasp_ee, q_left, 1.0)])
*** End Patch";
